requirements.quote:
When Initial and Handshake packet protection keys are discarded (see
   Section 4.9 of [QUIC-TLS]), all packets that were sent with those
   keys can no longer be acknowledged because their acknowledgments
   cannot be processed.
requirements.condition: Initial or Handshake packet protection keys have been discarded for packets sent using those keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat every packet sent with the discarded keys as no longer capable of being acknowledged because its acknowledgment cannot be processed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not process an acknowledgment as acknowledging a packet that was sent with discarded Initial or Handshake packet protection keys.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can discard the relevant keys, deliver acknowledgments for packets protected with those keys, and verify that the packets are not transitioned to acknowledged state.

requirements.quote:
When Initial and Handshake packet protection keys are discarded (see
   Section 4.9 of [QUIC-TLS]), all packets that were sent with those
   keys can no longer be acknowledged because their acknowledgments
   cannot be processed.  The sender MUST discard all recovery state
   associated with those packets and MUST remove them from the count of
   bytes in flight.
requirements.condition: Initial or Handshake packet protection keys are discarded.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender must discard all recovery state associated with every packet sent using those discarded keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not retain recovery state for any packet sent with the discarded keys.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Recovery-state entries for packets in each discarded-key epoch can be inspected after key discard and must all be absent.

requirements.quote:
When Initial and Handshake packet protection keys are discarded (see
   Section 4.9 of [QUIC-TLS]), all packets that were sent with those
   keys can no longer be acknowledged because their acknowledgments
   cannot be processed.  The sender MUST discard all recovery state
   associated with those packets and MUST remove them from the count of
   bytes in flight.
requirements.condition: Initial or Handshake packet protection keys are discarded.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender must remove every packet sent using those discarded keys from the bytes-in-flight count.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The sender must not continue counting any packet sent with the discarded keys as bytes in flight.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can record the bytes-in-flight contribution of affected packets, discard the keys, and verify that the contribution is removed.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints stop sending and receiving Initial packets once they start
   exchanging Handshake packets; see Section 17.2.2.1 of
   [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: An endpoint has started exchanging Handshake packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint stops sending Initial packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not send Initial packets after Handshake packet exchange has started.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet traces can verify that no Initial packet is emitted after Handshake packet exchange begins.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints stop sending and receiving Initial packets once they start
   exchanging Handshake packets; see Section 17.2.2.1 of
   [QUIC-TRANSPORT].
requirements.condition: An endpoint has started exchanging Handshake packets.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint stops receiving Initial packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not continue accepting or processing Initial packets after Handshake packet exchange has started.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject Initial packets after Handshake exchange begins and verify that they are not accepted or processed.

requirements.quote:
At this point, recovery state for all in-flight
   Initial packets is discarded.
requirements.condition: The endpoint starts exchanging Handshake packets and consequently stops sending and receiving Initial packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard recovery state for every in-flight Initial packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain recovery state for any in-flight Initial packet after this transition.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: The recovery-state table can be inspected at the Handshake-exchange transition to verify that all in-flight Initial entries are removed.

requirements.quote:
When 0-RTT is rejected, recovery state for all in-flight 0-RTT
   packets is discarded.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard recovery state for every in-flight 0-RTT packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain recovery state for any in-flight 0-RTT packet after 0-RTT rejection.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can reject 0-RTT with multiple in-flight 0-RTT packets and verify that all corresponding recovery entries are removed.

requirements.quote:
If a server accepts 0-RTT, but does not buffer 0-RTT packets that
   arrive before Initial packets, early 0-RTT packets will be declared
   lost, but that is expected to be infrequent.
requirements.condition: A server accepts 0-RTT but does not buffer 0-RTT packets that arrive before Initial packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Early 0-RTT packets that arrive before Initial packets are declared lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave such early, unbuffered 0-RTT packets indefinitely pending rather than declaring them lost.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet ordering and recovery state can be controlled to verify the loss declaration when the server does not buffer early 0-RTT packets.

requirements.quote: but that is expected to be infrequent.
requirements.condition: Early 0-RTT packets are declared lost because an accepting server does not buffer 0-RTT packets arriving before Initial packets.
requirements.required_behavior: Such occurrences are expected to be infrequent.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No concrete forbidden behavior is stated.
requirements.why_checkable: The term 'infrequent' has no threshold or measurement window, so it cannot support a deterministic implementation check.

requirements.quote:
It is expected that keys are discarded at some time after the packets
   encrypted with them are either acknowledged or declared lost.
requirements.condition: Packets encrypted with particular keys have been acknowledged or declared lost.
requirements.required_behavior: The keys are expected to be discarded at some later time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No bounded or otherwise concrete prohibition is stated.
requirements.why_checkable: The statement is an expectation and 'at some time after' provides no testable deadline, so it is not a deterministic conformance requirement.

requirements.quote:
However, Initial and Handshake secrets are discarded as soon as
   Handshake and 1-RTT keys are proven to be available to both client
   and server; see Section 4.9.1 of [QUIC-TLS].
requirements.condition: Handshake and 1-RTT keys have been proven available to both the client and the server.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard the Initial secrets immediately when that availability is proven.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain Initial secrets after Handshake and 1-RTT key availability has been proven for both endpoints.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Secret storage can be inspected at the proof-of-availability transition to verify immediate deletion of Initial secrets.

requirements.quote:
However, Initial and Handshake secrets are discarded as soon as
   Handshake and 1-RTT keys are proven to be available to both client
   and server; see Section 4.9.1 of [QUIC-TLS].
requirements.condition: Handshake and 1-RTT keys have been proven available to both the client and the server.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard the Handshake secrets immediately when that availability is proven.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain Handshake secrets after Handshake and 1-RTT key availability has been proven for both endpoints.
requirements.error_behavior: No separate error response is specified.
requirements.why_checkable: Secret storage can be inspected at the proof-of-availability transition to verify immediate deletion of Handshake secrets.
